name: Pyromancer: Timed Attacks grants 4% and 8% spell haste (#2407)
contract: #2407: Timed Attacks rank 1 (704812) and rank 2 (707803) are family 30 passives with one effect each: Effect 6, aura 216 (SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS), BasePoints 3 and 7, i.e. 4% and 8%. AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:4913) applies ApplyCastTimePercentMod, and neither id is in a spell_group or referenced by module code. Asserts the native cast-speed multiplier (smaller is faster) against a snapshot taken before learning: about 0.96 at rank 1 and 0.92 at rank 2 (bounds allow either a 1-x or 1/(1+x) formulation), and back to 1 after unlearning.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Unlearning restores the base cast speed
